title: Armatura hub
features:
Armatura Hub – Key Features:

Auto Farm – teleport between worlds/stages or custom coordinates.

Auto Buy Shop – automatically purchases all available items.

Auto Rebirth – triggers rebirth automatically.

Teleports – quick teleport to X2 Treadmill, Race Finish (two-point sequence), and all Sunken Shards.

Custom Teleport – teleport to any coordinates you enter.

Sound Spam – spam level-up sounds and toggle hearing them yourself.

Coords HUD – display your current position on screen.

Customizable UI – change background color (RGB) and transparency.

Mobile & PC compatible – works with most executors (Synapse, Krnl, Velocity, Xeno, Delta, etc.).

Settings saved – your preferences are stored locally.

Clean, draggable GUI – easy to use, minimize and restore.
